classes.name: Url
classes.description: Class responsible for URL parsing, manipulation, and rewriting within the OpenCart framework, including methods for generating links and managing URL rewrites.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the URL object by parsing the provided URL string into its components.

methods.name: addRewrite
methods.description: Adds a rewrite object to the URL rewrite chain if it implements the 'rewrite' method.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Generates a complete URL with an optional route and query arguments, applying rewrite rules and handling URL encoding quirks.
